nc6eacf44d72.s: Which department received the largest allocation in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27?
nc6eacf44d72.x: School Education received ₹32,308 crore, the largest departmental allocation in Budget 2026-27.

n63283decc88.s: In the AP Budget 2026-27, the Health Department (₹19,306 crore) ranked ____ among departments.
n63283decc88.x: Health ranks 4th, after School Education, BC Welfare and Panchayat Raj & Rural Development.

ne0ed93781fb.s: Hospitals in Andhra Pradesh halted Vaidya Seva services over unpaid dues of about:
ne0ed93781fb.x: Hospitals halted services over ₹3,000 crore of unpaid Vaidya Seva dues; the opposition called the insurance model a dilution of Aarogyasri.

nc2cc9090fae.s: According to SRS 2021-23, the Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) of Andhra Pradesh is:
nc2cc9090fae.x: SRS 2021-23 gives AP's MMR as 30 against India's 88; 45 was AP's SRS 2018-20 value and 19 is AP's IMR.

n3e35ba84f73.s: Which programme provides one full meal to pregnant and lactating women at Anganwadis?
n3e35ba84f73.x: Anna Amrutha Hastam provides one full meal to pregnant and lactating women at Anganwadis.

n02460d43575.s: YSR Sampoorna Poshana covers pregnant and lactating women and children aged:
n02460d43575.x: The programmes cover pregnant and lactating women and children aged 6 months to 6 years; Poshana Plus operates in tribal areas.

nb239de56375.s: Anna Canteens in Andhra Pradesh are primarily intended for the:
nb239de56375.x: Anna Canteens target the urban poor.

n0cbb1df3501.s: Sanjeevani, made statewide in AP from August 2026, gives every citizen a digital health profile and a(n):
n0cbb1df3501.x: Sanjeevani, piloted in Chittoor and Kuppam, provides every citizen a digital health profile and an ABHA ID.

na7233f19b95.s: The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission was launched in 2021 by:
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
na7233f19b95.x: ABDM was launched in 2021 by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

n50207182377.s: As reported by WDCW, child stunting in Andhra Pradesh declined from 21.21% to:

n9b941831eff.s: The LEAP initiative in Andhra Pradesh responds to poor learning outcomes reported by:
n9b941831eff.x: LEAP responds to poor learning outcomes reported by ASER.

n7ae8b7646c2.s: ICDS in Andhra Pradesh runs through 55,746 Anganwadi Centres under how many ICDS projects?
n7ae8b7646c2.x: AP has 55,746 Anganwadi Centres and 257 ICDS projects; 173 is the number of CHCs and 559 of urban PHCs.

nb346c47670e.s: The headquarters of the Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA) is at:
nb346c47670e.x: The headquarters of APCRDA is at Rayapudi.

o: AP Metropolitan Region and Urban Development Authorities Act, 2016
nbb41e1ad98e.x: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority was established under the APCRDA Act, 2014.

n72029d512f5.s: Amaravati is planned as a greenfield capital city on the banks of which river?
n72029d512f5.x: Amaravati is a greenfield city on the Krishna between Vijayawada and Guntur, in Thullur mandal.

n25a5c149d10.s: PMAY-Urban 2.0 in Andhra Pradesh mainly provides:
n25a5c149d10.x: PMAY-Urban 2.0 is a housing scheme intended to provide pucca houses.

ncecfc15ec1c.s: YSR Jagananna Colonies provide house sites and houses to poor women under:
ncecfc15ec1c.x: YSR Jagananna Colonies provide house sites and houses for poor women under Navaratnalu-Pedalandariki Illu.

n4e19983f610.s: Which body is the nodal agency in AP for placement-linked training through Skill Hubs and Skill Spokes?
n4e19983f610.x: APSSDC is the nodal agency for placement-linked training through Skill Hubs, Skill Spokes, colleges and Sector Skill Councils.

n53be9b286f6.s: Skill Census 2024 in Andhra Pradesh maps which of the following for 100% of the youth?
n53be9b286f6.x: Skill Census 2024 is a household survey to map the skills, qualifications and jobs of 100% of youth.

n907a85e6503.s: VB-G RAM G was launched nationally at which place in Andhra Pradesh?
n907a85e6503.x: The national launch of VB-G RAM G took place at Mukkavaripalli in Tirupati district.

n9be9c278c3d.s: OMCAP is the nodal agency for overseas recruitment in Andhra Pradesh under the:
n9be9c278c3d.x: OMCAP (Overseas Manpower Company AP Ltd) is the nodal agency for overseas recruitment under the Emigration Act, 1983.

n5df3c7345b2.s: Which Super Six scheme provides an announced ₹3,000 a month to unemployed youth?
n5df3c7345b2.x: Nirudyoga Bruthi, a Super Six promise, provides ₹3,000 a month to unemployed youth; Yuva Nestham was the 2014-19 allowance scheme.

n5556f1e0d59.s: Under Mana Biyyam (2013), BPL families got fine rice at ₹1 per kg up to a ceiling of:
n5556f1e0d59.x: Mana Biyyam provided fine rice at ₹1 per kg to BPL families, with a maximum of 20 kg per family.

n5a1ea85910b.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: YSR Jagananna Housing – launched in April 2006
n5a1ea85910b.x: YSR Jagananna Housing was launched on 3 June 2021; April 2006 is the launch of INDIRAMMA.

n24b2219e517.s: Mission Shakti in AP runs One Stop Centres in all districts and operates which helpline?
n24b2219e517.x: Mission Shakti runs One Stop Centres in all districts and operates the 181 helpline.

n69114dbdf56.s: Jagananna Vidya Deevena and Vasathi Deevena are respectively associated with:
o: Full fee reimbursement and hostel costs
Hostel costs and full fee reimbursement
n69114dbdf56.x: Vidya Deevena provides full fee reimbursement, while Vasathi Deevena supports hostel costs.

n310cb19f9ac.s: The AP Disha Bill, 2019, which never received assent, was withdrawn by the State Cabinet in:
n310cb19f9ac.x: The Cabinet withdrew the Disha Bill in August 2026 on the Centre's advice after the BNS and BNSS came into force.

ned8981a63da.s:
Assertion (A): In the AP Budget 2022-23, expenditure excluding debt repayment was estimated at ₹2,39,986 crore.
Reason (R): This was 14% above the 2021-22 Revised Estimates.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ned8981a63da.x: Both are true (APPSC 2023), but a growth rate over the previous RE does not explain the size of the estimate, so R does not explain A.

neb9a484e6b6.s: High interest payments, administrative costs and welfare commitments in AP's finances lead to:
o: Fiscal rigidity and crowding out of capital outlay
neb9a484e6b6.x: These committed items create fiscal rigidity and crowd out capital outlay.

n38598efa715.s: In budget classification, welfare spending such as pensions and recurring subsidies is:
n38598efa715.x: Welfare schemes are revenue expenditure; they create no assets and impose recurring liabilities, so they can widen the revenue deficit.

n61ad7ea2321.s: During 2014-15 to 2023-24, capital expenditure of all States formed about what share of their total spending?
n61ad7ea2321.x: Capital expenditure was about 13–20 percent of total spending of all States, revenue expenditure about 80–87 percent.

nbb37899f77c.s: Andhra Pradesh's higher capital outlay is directed mainly towards:
o: Irrigation and flood control, water supply and sanitation, and urban development
Rice subsidy, fee reimbursement and DBT schemes
Police, general administration and tax collection
nbb37899f77c.x: Higher capital outlay is directed towards irrigation and flood control, water supply and sanitation, and urban development.

ncfe4c93feac.s: AP's own tax revenue is about 5.5–6.4% of GSDP. The average for States is about:
ncfe4c93feac.x: The States' average is about 7% of GSDP, so AP is below it; the Planning Department flagged a 'relatively low own-revenue ratio'.

n7bdad9d4f5e.s: Excise revenue, mainly from liquor, is Andhra Pradesh's ____ own-tax source.
n7bdad9d4f5e.x: Excise, principally liquor revenue, is AP's second-largest own-tax source.

nac63d48238d.s: In AP's 2025-26 RE, the second-largest source of own non-tax revenue after Mines and Minerals was:
nac63d48238d.x: Mines and Minerals accounted for 37 per cent and Medical and Health for 34 per cent of non-tax revenue in 2025-26 RE.

n514e0a75330.s: Profits and dividends of State PSUs in Andhra Pradesh are treated as:
o: Non-tax revenue retained by the State
n514e0a75330.x: Profits and dividends of State PSUs are non-tax revenue retained by the State.

n5c5dd9658e5.s: Royalty on minerals is levied ad valorem on the:
o: Market value of the lease area
n5c5dd9658e5.x: Under the MMDR Act, 1957, royalty is levied ad valorem on the Average Sale Price.

nd6926bae578.s:
Regarding the Supreme Court's position on mineral royalty, consider:
1. Royalty is not a tax.
2. States cannot tax mineral-bearing land.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nd6926bae578.x: The Supreme Court reaffirmed that royalty is not a tax and that States may tax mineral-bearing land, so statement 2 is wrong.

n1f4ce4d3399.s: Which feature of Centrally Sponsored Schemes limits Andhra Pradesh's fiscal flexibility?
n1f4ce4d3399.x: CSS make up about 40% of central transfers and carry rigid co-financing conditions, limiting the State's flexibility.

n957df58dfc7.s: Andhra Pradesh's tax devolution in the 2026-27 Budget Estimates was:
n957df58dfc7.x: 2026-27 BE provides ₹64,362 crore; ₹50,475 crore and ₹52,080 crore were the 2024-25 BE and RE.

n07464947da9.s: For unconditional cash transfers, the Economic Survey 2025-26 urged:
n07464947da9.x: The Economic Survey 2025-26 urged conditional transfers or sunset clauses for unconditional cash transfers.

nf46656c4be7.s: Non-tax revenue contributes about what share of Andhra Pradesh's revenue receipts?
nf46656c4be7.x: Non-tax revenue is only about 4% of AP's revenue receipts; mining is the principal lever controlled by the State.

nbc5ec33f7a7.s: The District Mineral Foundation is a non-profit trust constituted under which Section of the MMDR Amendment Act, 2015?
nbc5ec33f7a7.x: The DMF is a non-profit trust established under Section 9B of the MMDR Amendment Act, 2015.

n7b2c9f575dd.s: Which pair relating to the 16th Finance Commission award to Andhra Pradesh (2026–31) is correctly matched?
n7b2c9f575dd.x: The 16th FC awarded ₹6,125 crore for disaster management; rural and urban local body grants are ₹16,627 crore and ₹12,158 crore respectively.

nb657a8ad255.s: Andhra Pradesh's share in the divisible pool under the 16th Finance Commission is:
nb657a8ad255.x: AP's share is 4.217% under the 16th FC, against about 4.05% under the 15th FC.

nc61920b4737.s: Andhra Pradesh received post-devolution revenue deficit grants under which Finance Commission(s)?
nc61920b4737.x: AP, a chronic revenue-deficit State after 2014, received these grants under the 14th and 15th Finance Commissions.

n5e307e06e10.s: Which was Andhra Pradesh's fastest-growing revenue head in the 2024-25 Budget, rising by 60%?
n5e307e06e10.x: Excise was the fastest-growing head in the 2024-25 Budget with 60% growth; it formed about 22% of own-tax revenue in the RE.

nc23b0de8773.s: The 128% rise in AP's Agriculture and Allied allocation (2024-25 RE to 2025-26 BE) is partly due to a:
o: Reclassification of subsidies as capital receipts
Abolition of the Annadata Sukhibhava scheme
nc23b0de8773.x: Agriculture was budgeted at Rs. 12,514 crore in 2024-25 but the RE was only Rs. 6,192 crore, so growth to Rs. 14,138 crore looks large (low-base effect).

n594d109cb7b.s:
Arrange Andhra Pradesh's debt-GSDP ratios for the following years in ascending order:
A. 2023-24 RE
B. 2026-27 BE
C. 2022-23 Actual
D. 2024-25 BE

n806cd31b9a7.s: The FRBM framework, as amended in 2018, set General and Central Government debt ceilings for 31 March 2025 at:
n806cd31b9a7.x: The amended FRBM framework set a General Government debt ceiling of 60% of GDP and a Central Government ceiling of 40% by 31 March 2025.

nadb83da5c58.s: By November 2025, Andhra Pradesh's non-tax revenue collection stood at:
o: About one-third of the Budget Estimate
Below one-fifth of the Budget Estimate
Over one-half of the Budget Estimate
About one-fourth of the Budget Estimate
nadb83da5c58.x: By November 2025, non-tax revenue collection was below one-fifth of the Budget Estimate.

nindian-economy-45-5.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-economy-45-5.x: Corporation tax is tax revenue; interest receipts are non-tax revenue, market borrowings a capital receipt and pensions revenue expenditure.

n28314645bc3.s: The principal concern about off-budget borrowings and State guarantees is that they:
n28314645bc3.x: Off-budget borrowings and guarantees obscure the true consolidated debt and may pressure sovereign ratings.

n8f580b85d02.s: The first Budget of residuary Andhra Pradesh after bifurcation (2014) was presented by:
n8f580b85d02.x: Yanamala Ramakrishnudu presented the first Budget of residuary Andhra Pradesh in 2014.

nf23a7319abc.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Article 279A – Concurrent power to make GST laws
nf23a7319abc.x: Article 269A concerns IGST; Article 246A gives concurrent GST legislative power and Article 279A establishes the GST Council.

n28fcf6815ae.s: Off-budget borrowing by Andhra Pradesh refers to:
o: Direct State borrowing included in reported public debt
Grants received from the Finance Commission
Loans raised by State PSUs or corporations, serviced from the State budget but excluded from reported debt
Loans from foreign governments not guaranteed by the State
n28fcf6815ae.x: Off-budget borrowings are raised by State entities but serviced from the State budget and kept outside reported debt.

neb58150fb02.s: AP's debt-GSDP ratio of about 36% is well above the N.K. Singh benchmark for States of:
neb58150fb02.x: The N.K. Singh benchmark for States is 20% of GSDP (Centre 40%), so AP's ~36% is well above it.

n4e86a2488fc.s: The P4 (Public-Private-People Partnership) model in Andhra Pradesh aims at zero poverty within:
n4e86a2488fc.x: P4 aims at zero poverty in five years, treating the family as the unit and linking DBT beneficiaries to jobs and self-employment.

n077fd04c7a6.s: During the Plan era, State Plans were financed through the State's own resources and:
n077fd04c7a6.x: State Plans were financed by own resources plus Normal Central Assistance allocated under the Gadgil or Gadgil-Mukherjee formula.

na3b2e0d2dc6.s: The Sixteenth Finance Commission urged that Centrally Sponsored Schemes be:
na3b2e0d2dc6.x: The Sixteenth Finance Commission urges outcome-linked Centrally Sponsored Schemes.

o: Sharing Polavaram costs between two States
n99aa032170f.x: SNA-SPARSH enables just-in-time release of CSS funds through State IFMIS, RBI e-Kuber and PFMS.

n4d7b62c1d91.s: Which Finance Commission did not distinguish Special and General Category States in its devolution formula?
n4d7b62c1d91.x: The Fourteenth Finance Commission did not distinguish Special and General Category States in its devolution formula.

nb6195dedd7b.s: In the 2024-25 RE, total central resources to AP rose despite a fall in grants mainly because of:
nb6195dedd7b.x: Grants fell short of the Budget Estimate, but total resources rose because EAP loans were included in the Revised Estimate.

n6079a4c5ae1.s: Andhra Pradesh's real GSDP growth in 2025-26 was:
n6079a4c5ae1.x: AP's real GSDP grew 9.88% against India's 7.4%; 10.75% was AP's nominal growth.

nced50940b2c.s: Which was the fastest-growing agriculture sub-sector in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26?
nced50940b2c.x: Fishing and aquaculture was the fastest-growing agriculture sub-sector in 2025-26 (17.69% per the Survey; one overview gives 16.0%).

nb7968c38dfd.s: As per Census 2011, the sex ratio of Andhra Pradesh was:
nb7968c38dfd.x: AP's sex ratio was 997; 944 was its child sex ratio.

nd30eeb9bc4e.s: The Apex Council constituted under Section 84 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 is chaired by the:
o: Chief Ministers of both States jointly
nd30eeb9bc4e.x: The Apex Council is chaired by the Union Water Resources Minister, with the Chief Ministers of both States as members.

n4e8debc3cac.s: Which provision of Section 94 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 is correctly matched?
o: Section 94(2) – Special support for the new capital
Section 94(3) – Denotification of degraded forest land
Section 94(1) – Fiscal measures including tax incentives
n4e8debc3cac.x: 94(1) covers fiscal measures, 94(2) backward-area infrastructure, 94(3) special support for the new capital and 94(4) denotification of degraded forest land.

ne65c57cc8fc.s: Under Schedule XII of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, the State Load Despatch Centre was shared for up to:
ne65c57cc8fc.x: The SLDC was shared for up to two years, while APERC acted as a joint regulator for up to six months.

n7d0b65be69b.s: The territorial bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh took effect on the appointed day, which was:
n7d0b65be69b.x: The Act was enacted on 1 March 2014 (President's assent), but the territorial split took effect on the appointed day, 2 June 2014.

n0d44bedf450.s: Special Category Status, introduced in 1969 in the Fifth Finance Commission era, was first given to:
o: Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh and Assam
Jammu and Kashmir, Assam and Nagaland
n0d44bedf450.x: Special Category Status began in 1969 for Jammu and Kashmir, Assam and Nagaland.

n4c42396587c.s: The CSS funding pattern (Centre:State) for Special Category States and for other States is respectively:
n4c42396587c.x: Special Category States get a 90:10 pattern, against 60:40 under the ordinary CSS pattern.

nfeec8d858b8.s:
About externally aided projects (EAPs) under the special assistance measure for Andhra Pradesh:
1. The Centre repays the loans and interest of EAPs signed between 2015-16 and 2019-20.
2. The Centre bears 60 per cent of the EAP cost.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nfeec8d858b8.x: Statement 1 is correct; statement 2 is wrong because the Centre bears 90 per cent of the EAP cost.

nf16d989c832.s: After bifurcation, residuary Andhra Pradesh received about what share of revenue while bearing a larger share of debt?
nf16d989c832.x: Residuary AP received about 46% of the revenue but had to bear a larger share of the debt.

n87d32689a32.s: In discharging his special responsibility in the common capital, the Governor acts:
o: On the advice of the Telangana Council of Ministers
In his individual judgment after consulting the Telangana Council of Ministers
On the advice of the Andhra Pradesh Council of Ministers
On the advice of both State Legislatures
n87d32689a32.x: The Governor exercises individual judgment after consulting the Telangana Council of Ministers, and the decision is final.

n4fc5d960664.s: At bifurcation, cash balances held in treasuries were divided:
o: By the location of the treasury
In the population ratio, by adjustment in RBI books
By the place of assessment of taxes
n4fc5d960664.x: Treasury cash balances were apportioned in the population ratio and adjusted in RBI books, with no physical transfer.

n4228e1db522.s: Under Section 95, the Article 371D admission quotas and common admission process in higher, technical and medical institutions continued for:
n4228e1db522.x: Section 95 continued the 371D quotas and common admission process for ten years in government and private, aided and unaided institutions.

na6215716905.s: Andhra Pradesh complained that after bifurcation it got about 46% of revenue but inherited about what share of the debt?
na6215716905.x: Assets followed location but debts followed population, so AP got about 46% of revenue but inherited 58% of the debt.

n90dbfe1f5f1.s: Who chaired the committee associated with the partition of the 1953 Andhra State?
n90dbfe1f5f1.x: The 1953 Andhra State partition committee was chaired by T. T. Krishnamachari.

nf93f646a863.s: Under the Twelfth Schedule of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, APGENCO power plants were divided on the basis of:
nf93f646a863.x: APGENCO plants go by location and existing PPAs with the DISCOMs continue.

n20dc779f0e7.s: After the 16th Finance Commission ended revenue deficit grants, the Centre sanctioned how much for Amaravati to help AP tide over?
n20dc779f0e7.x: The Centre sanctioned Rs 15,000 crore for Amaravati plus other assistance; Rs 38,000 crore is AP's claimed loss and Rs 22,113 crore the 14th FC RD grant.

n476c17390a6.s: World Bank and ADB assistance for Amaravati, on concessional terms of 0.6% plus TONA, amounts to:
n476c17390a6.x: The World Bank and ADB assistance amounts to Rs 15,000 crore at 0.6% plus TONA; Rs 11,000 crore is the HUDCO loan.

n0256ec99977.s: AIIB assistance in Andhra Pradesh supports:
n0256ec99977.x: AIIB supports urban water supply and sewerage projects; JICA funds APILIP-II, NDB the roads and ADB the VCIC.

n1ad145b9354.s: The AP Integrated Irrigation and Agriculture Transformation Project covers climate resilience and productivity in:
n1ad145b9354.x: APIIATP focuses on climate resilience and productivity in 565 minor-tank villages across 22 districts.

nf58ee2ca7f0.s: Which of the following projects in Andhra Pradesh is funded by the World Bank?
o: AP Irrigation and Livelihood Project Phase-II
nf58ee2ca7f0.x: AP Health Systems Strengthening is World Bank-funded; the Green Energy Corridor is KfW, APILIP-II is JICA and VCIC is ADB.

n0761b5dde09.s: The World Bank-funded AP Road Sector Project provides for repair and strengthening of about how many km of major district roads and State highways?
n0761b5dde09.x: The AP Road Sector Project covers 850 km of major district roads and State highways; 539.45 km and 728.59 km are NDB Phase-II figures.

n5e9cf9a3fda.s: AP's special package for backward districts was modelled on Odisha's KBK package and the ____ package.
n5e9cf9a3fda.x: The backward-district package drew on the KBK (Koraput-Bolangir-Kalahandi) package of Odisha and the Bundelkhand special package.

n719f915e0e8.s: The lack of anchor industries in Srikakulam and Vizianagaram has contributed to:
n719f915e0e8.x: The absence of anchor industries in Srikakulam and Vizianagaram contributes to distress migration.

neca11136411.s: Rayalaseema has a low population density mainly because of:
neca11136411.x: Recurring droughts and famines are identified as the major reasons for Rayalaseema's low population density.
